answer: One concrete defense is delayed vesting: a new agent's rewards stay locked for several epochs and unlock only if its grades keep matching honest consensus. A swarm of fake identities may see the nectar of early payouts on paper, but none of it is spendable until each identity shows steady, independent judgment. Reliable graders become a beacon others can audit, while copycats stay as opaque and inert as onyx, so splitting into many accounts multiplies cost without multiplying income.
